commit 8812bfd95084e732067ceebfb6ca186a5cca4348
Author:     Patrick Schaub <patrick@schaub.systems>
AuthorDate: Mon Jun 9 23:35:34 2025 +0000
Commit:     Patrick Schaub <patrick@schaub.systems>
CommitDate: Mon Jun 9 23:35:34 2025 +0000

    Bug 1876691 - Fix MSIX mailto protocol to use -compose instead of -url r=mkmelin
    
    
    MSIX AppxManifest was using -osint -url for mailto protocol, which doesn't
    properly handle email composition. Changed to -osint -compose to match
    the NSIS implementation and provide correct mailto functionality.
    
    r?mkmelin
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D253110

diff --git a/mail/installer/windows/msix/AppxManifest.xml.in b/mail/installer/windows/msix/AppxManifest.xml.in
index 80b86f46243..bfc7713ab1f 100644
--- a/mail/installer/windows/msix/AppxManifest.xml.in
+++ b/mail/installer/windows/msix/AppxManifest.xml.in
@@ -87,7 +87,7 @@
           </uap3:FileTypeAssociation>
         </uap3:Extension>
         <uap3:Extension Category="windows.protocol">
-          <uap3:Protocol Name="mailto" Parameters="-osint -url "%1"">
+          <uap3:Protocol Name="mailto" Parameters="-osint -compose "%1"">
             <uap:DisplayName>mailto</uap:DisplayName>
             <uap:Logo>Assets\Email44x44.png</uap:Logo>
           </uap3:Protocol>
title: Bug 1876691 - Fix MSIX mailto protocol to use -compose instead of -url r=mkmelin
